editorial.blurb: Siam Thai Eatery is a beautifully designed South Loop destination delivering exceptional, authentic Thai cuisine that rivals Bangkok itself.
editorial.insiderTip: Make a reservation ahead for peak hours, arrive by car using SpotHero for parking in this tricky South Loop area, and bring your own bottle (BYOB with cork fee).
